assets.imagegen_prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: website card illustration for a residential construction financing landing page. Primary request: create an on-brand parcel feasibility sketch asset for FairLend's Parcel sketch tab, showing a top-down residential lot, buildable envelope, main multiplex massing, rear laneway-suite option, setback guides, frontage tick marks, and professional feasibility markups. Scene/backdrop: clean planning-desk blueprint sheet, no surrounding page UI or browser chrome. Subject: a single urban infill parcel diagram with lot boundary, soft blueprint grid, dimension ticks, buildable-area overlay, main building rectangle, rear suite pad, driveway/lane hint, and a few small lender/permit review marks. Style/medium: refined editorial technical illustration, premium financial/property-consulting brand, crisp vector-like drafting lines rendered as a raster image. Composition/framing: landscape rectangle, centered diagram, generous padding, readable at small card size, slight paper texture, no perspective distortion. Lighting/mood: calm, analytical, high-end advisory, clear and pragmatic. Color palette: warm ivory paper, pale blueprint blue, deep ink navy, muted teal, restrained FairLend green accents, small electric lime highlights. Materials/textures: subtle paper grain, fine drafting linework, translucent buildable-area washes. Text: none. Constraints: no words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no people, no photoreal house photo, no screenshot UI, no browser frame, no cast shadow outside the asset.
